proposal.summary: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 have incorrect ACLs on the local installation folder, allowing wide-ranging local user privileges that may enable system destruction or execution of malicious programs.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed, therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

AV.quote: a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

PR.quote: a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

C.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system

I.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

A.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or verify vendor-supplied advisory or patch notes for CHS 3.5.3 that describe the ACL change; obtain reproduction steps or exploit PoC to confirm required privileges and impact scope.
